name: cc-income-tax
description: Selected Cocos (Keeling) Islands individual income-tax rules for 2026-27. Establishes the Australian territorial bridge, residence and income-year gates, ordinary resident and foreign-resident personal rates, conditional part-year threshold, low income tax offset, standard work-expense deduction, substantiation changes, special-area zone relief and ordinary Medicare reductions, single-person, family/period and ordinary surviving spouse surcharge screening (the surcharge, reportable-super and concessional-cap worksheets are in cc-medicare-levy-surcharge). Use for Cocos (Keeling) Islands personal tax, ordinary annual rates, mainland moves or levy-exemption questions. Includes primary legislation, fictional component calculations, required intake, refusals and reviewer checks. This source-cited draft accepts taxable income only after all applicable income and deduction rules are resolved; it does not complete a return or the country pack.
